# Discover Parbat

> Discover Parbat is a small, locally owned trekking company from Parbat district, Nepal, running locally guided treks from Pokhara in the Annapurna and Dhaulagiri region, plus selected treks elsewhere in Nepal. It is known for opening the Kokhe Danda Trek, a quiet homestay trek to the highest point of Parbat district, and for routes that avoid the busiest trails.

Key facts:

- Founder and lead guide: Sameer Regmi, born and raised in Parbat (https://discoverparbat.com/about#sameer-regmi)
- Based in Parbat district and Pokhara, Gandaki Province, Nepal
- Started in 2017 as a Facebook page promoting places in Parbat; the Kokhe Danda route was found in 2020; became a trekking company in 2022
- Guides are local to Parbat and the villages along the routes
- Focus: authentic village and homestay experiences (Magar and Gurung villages such as Haljure and Lespar), quiet trails, small groups
- Contact: info@discoverparbat.com, WhatsApp +977 986 7649780
- Reviews: Google Maps https://maps.app.goo.gl/wJ8wzmghg8FJQt8T8 and Tripadvisor https://www.tripadvisor.com/Attraction_Review-g293891-d27141838-Reviews-Discover_Parbat-Pokhara_Gandaki_Zone_Western_Region.html

## Treks

- [Kokhe Danda Trek](https://discoverparbat.com/kokhe-danda-trek): 5 easy days from Pokhara to Kokhe Danda (3,309 m), the highest point of Parbat, with family homestays in Haljure and Lespar and Dhaulagiri and Annapurna views. A trail opened by Discover Parbat; a quiet alternative to Poon Hill.
- [Short Kokhe Danda Trek](https://discoverparbat.com/short-kokhe-danda-trek): 3-day version of the Kokhe Danda Trek.
- [Khopra Ridge Trek](https://discoverparbat.com/khopra-ridge-trek): 8 days via Tadapani, Dobato, Muldai Viewpoint, Khopra Ridge (3,667 m), Poon Hill and Kokhe Danda; optional Khayer Lake (4,653 m).
- [Muldai Viewpoint Trek](https://discoverparbat.com/muldai-viewpoint-trek): 6 days via Dobato, Muldai Viewpoint (3,637 m), Poon Hill and Kokhe Danda, with a Lespar homestay.
- [4-Day Poon Hill Trek](https://discoverparbat.com/poonhill-trek): short Poon Hill route from Banthati, climbing Poon Hill after the sunrise crowds, then Kokhe Danda and Lespar.
- [Panchase Trek](https://discoverparbat.com/panchase-trek): 3 easy days from Pokhara via Kushma, with a Gurung homestay in Arthar.
- [Mardi Himal Trek](https://discoverparbat.com/mardi-himal-trek): 5 days from Pokhara to the Mardi Himal viewpoints below Machhapuchhre.
- [Mardi Himal and Poon Hill Trek](https://discoverparbat.com/mardi-himal-and-poonhill-trek): 10 days combining Mardi Himal, Ghandruk, Poon Hill and Kokhe Danda.
- [Mardi Himal and Khopra Ridge Trek](https://discoverparbat.com/multiple-viewpoints-trek): 12 or 14 days linking Mardi Himal and Khopra Ridge, with Khayer Lake, Poon Hill and Kokhe Danda.
- [Annapurna Base Camp Trek](https://discoverparbat.com/annapurna-base-camp-trek): 10-day locally guided route to Annapurna Base Camp.
- [Annapurna Circuit Trek](https://discoverparbat.com/annapurna-circuit-trek): 12 days over Thorong La (5,416 m).
- [Pikey Peak Trek](https://discoverparbat.com/pikey-peak-trek): 7 days to Pikey Peak (4,065 m) with views of Everest, Makalu and Kanchenjunga.
- [Everest View Trek](https://discoverparbat.com/everest-view-trek): 7 days from Lukla via Namche Bazaar, Hotel Everest View (3,880 m), Khumjung and Tengboche.
- [Api Himal Base Camp Trek](https://discoverparbat.com/api-himal-base-camp-trek): 14 days to the foot of Api (7,132 m) in far-western Nepal.
- [Custom trek](https://discoverparbat.com/custom-trek): tailor-made treks on request.

## Trek news

- [Annapurna North Base Camp: new ACAP checkpoint at Baskot](https://discoverparbat.com/article/annapurna-north-base-camp-acap-checkpoint): from 21 Nov 2026 ACAP permits are checked at Baskot, Narchyang, on the Annapurna North Base Camp (Annapurna I / Maurice Herzog Base Camp) trail; fees, route and crowds.
